_meta.description: Real Brex (api.brex.com) GET /v2/transactions/card/primary response. CURSOR pagination: top-level `items` array + `next_cursor` (a token, or null on the LAST page). There is NO `total` field. This fixture is the TERMINAL page (`next_cursor: null`), so the client must recognize the absence of a follow token as 'no more pages'. The pre-fix client used Mercury-style offset/`total` pagination (`resp.get('total', len(txns))`) and stopped after page 1; the additive fix follows `next_cursor` when present and keeps the offset/`total` path as a fallback for the synthetic spammer. Doc-derived; ids/amounts are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://developer.brex.com/openapi/transactions_api + https://developer.brex.com/docs/pagination/ (GET /v2/transactions/card/primary -> {items[], next_cursor}; cursor/limit query params; next_cursor is nil at end of set; scope transactions.card.readonly)
